name: Publir – Holistic Revenue Engine (HRE)
author: publirump

sections.description:
Publir’s Holistic Revenue Engine (HRE) plugin helps WordPress publishers increase revenue through two integrated solutions:

  • Dynamic Ad Optimization
  • Audience Monetization

Easily deploy high-paying programmatic ads, a premium subscription paywall, and clean user experiences with a single plugin.

Dynamic Ad Optimization Get the highest-paying ad on every page, across every device. Publir’s engine uses real-time header bidding, AI-based targeting, and 150+ ad tech integrations to maximize earnings — with fast, low-latency delivery.

Audience Monetization Convert casual readers into paid subscribers with smart paywalls, ad-free options, and flexible pricing. Use built-in reporting tools to grow your subscriber base and collect zero-party data.

Built for WordPress Publir HRE is tailor-made for WordPress. Whether you’re a solo creator or large publisher, you can integrate a complete monetization engine without code, complexity, or ad ops teams.

External Dependencies

We are using Amazon Web Services to track Ad block page views for our clients. To facilitate tracking, our plugin will call:
https://{amazon_service_node}.amazonaws.com/default/pAnalytics To fetch currency details and site-specific customizations, the plugin uses:
https://a.publir.com/subscriptions/{siteId}.json
sections.installation:
Install from Plugins > Add New > Search “Publir HRE”.

Activate the plugin.

Enter your:

  • Publir Site ID (get this from Login)
  • Register/Login Page URL

Save changes.

For help: publir.com
sections.faq:
What is Publir?

Publir is a unified monetization platform, helping publishers grow revenue through smart advertising and subscriptions.

How soon can I expect growth in subscriptions?

Results vary, but most sites see steady subscriber growth with consistent content and promotion.

How long does setup take?

Account creation is self-service and takes about 5 minutes. You can register directly via Register

What are Publir’s current products?

  • Dynamic Ad Optimization
  • Audience Monetization
